assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias.
To accurately capture the frequency and duration of these episodic symptoms for appropriate rate and rhythm control management, a mobile cardiac telemetry study is ordered.
Diagnosis codes I49.9 and I48.91 support the service.
The service addresses the denial determination under Reason Code PR-204.
This specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan.
